title: Soft Hands Win Tres Idiomas
style: modern viral pop country, acoustic guitar with claps, programmed kick, banjo accent, bright female lead with male harmony, three-language verse rotation, pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting confident, 100 bpm, festival pop
lyrics:
[Intro]
Soft hands win, soft hands win
Patience is the way, every game begin

[Verse 1 — English]
They come in fast, they come in strong
Power swings all night long
But the soft game answers every time
Reset the rally, find the line
Gentle little drop, gentle little touch
Patience always wins, it does so much

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Soft hands win, manos suaves ganan, ruǎn shǒu yíng
Patience plays, paciencia juega, nài xīn dǎ
Reset the rally, reinicia la jugada, chóng xīn kāi shǐ
Soft hands win, manos suaves ganan, ruǎn shǒu yíng

[Verse 2 — Español]
Llegan con fuerza, llegan con son
Golpes muy duros, sin atención
Pero el juego suave siempre responde
Reinicia la bola, encuentra el orden
Toque suave, control sereno
Paciencia gana, eso es lo bueno

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Soft hands win, manos suaves ganan, ruǎn shǒu yíng
Patience plays, paciencia juega, nài xīn dǎ
Reset the rally, reinicia la jugada, chóng xīn kāi shǐ
Soft hands win, manos suaves ganan, ruǎn shǒu yíng

[Verse 3 — 中文]
Tā men dǎ de qiáng, shēng yīn dà
Dàn shì ruǎn shǒu zǒng shì yíng
Chóng xīn kāi shǐ, zhǎo hǎo xiàn
Qīng qiāo chū shǒu, qīng qiāo wěn jiàn
Nài xīn de rén, hùi dé qí lè
Nài xīn yǒng yuǎn shì shéng zhě

[Bridge]
Let them swing, deja que jueguen, ràng tā men dǎ
The rally is long, the patient player wins
La jugada es larga, el paciente gana
Nài xīn de yíng, màn màn yíng

[Outro]
Soft hands win, manos suaves ganan, ruǎn shǒu yíng
Viral viral, viral viral
Soft hands win forever
